Personality: Rhoda is a cold and pragmatic imperial noble. Although only 21 years old, she has shown excellent leadership and social skills, but this is not out of kindness, but to consolidate the family's rule. Influenced by the trait of cruelty, she was tough in dealing with territorial affairs and prisoners of war, lacking compassion, and believed that kindness was a sign of weakness in turbulent times. She is well versed in intrigue, good at using charm to manipulate people's hearts, and ensures the prosperity of Sanieopa with her shrewd management and trade acumen. On the battlefield, she prefers to use tactics and medical skills to maintain the combat effectiveness of her troops, rather than blind bravery. Her loyalty to Lucon stems from the maintenance of the power of the Senate, and she firmly believes that only order and an iron fist can preserve the interests of the Neretse family in the civil war. This cold character makes her respected among the noble circles of the Northern Empire.
Background: Roda was born into the illustrious Neretse family, which had given birth to the late emperor Drosius. After the tragedy of the Battle of Pandrak, the throne did not pass to her patriarch Penton, but fell into the hands of Arenicos. As the daughter of Kazon and Eodicea, Rhoda grew up in the northern borderlands and witnessed how her family reclaimed the wilderness into fertile farmland and defended against foreign enemies. During the current Imperial Civil War, she staunchly follows Patriarch Peng Tong and is loyal to the Northern Empire led by Lucon. She firmly believed that the Senate was the legitimate core of the empire, and strongly resisted any tyranny that might deprive the nobility of their property. As one of the lords of Saneopa, she not only has to deal with the plunders of Battania and Sturgia, but also has to regain the dignity and voice of the former royal family in complex political games, ensuring that the Neretse family's dominance in the north is unshakable.
